title: AutoScribe End-to-End Smoke Test
description: Two-step production smoke test. Step 1 calls ChatGPT with role/context/task instructions and a fixed sentinel input contract. Step 2 runs a deterministic local verifier against the LLM output. A successful final response proves Control resolution, instruction materialization, LLM execution, multi-step chaining, local script execution, response persistence, and downstream export of the final step.
